settings.aboutText:
Saumya Enterprises is an India-based export and trading company focused on supplying quality agricultural products to international buyers. Based in Tetari Bazar, Siddharthnagar, Uttar Pradesh, we source fresh produce through our network of farms and traders, grade it to buyer requirements, and coordinate packing, documentation and shipment.

We began with Indian Red Onion and White Onion, and are building a multi-product export platform that will grow into dry fruits, spices and other agricultural commodities. Our aim is simple: long-term relationships with importers, wholesalers and distributors built on quality, fair pricing and timely delivery.

posts.title: How to choose onion size and grade for import
posts.excerpt: Size, colour, firmness and packing all affect shelf life and resale value. Here is a practical checklist for importers.
posts.body:
Choosing the right onion specification before you place an order saves time, money and rejected stock. Here are the points importers most often confirm with their supplier.

## 1. Size range
Onions are usually sold by diameter. A common range is Small (25–40 mm), Medium (40–55 mm), Large (55–70 mm) and Extra Large (70 mm and above). Supermarkets often prefer medium and large; processors may accept a wider range.

## 2. Colour and skin
Red onions should show an even red to deep purple skin. White onions should be clean white to pale cream. Dry, intact outer skins protect the bulb during transport.

## 3. Firmness and condition
Onions should feel firm and crisp, free from visible rot, sprouting and excessive damage. Always agree on an inspection method before shipment.

## 4. Packing
Mesh bags allow air to move through the load, which is important for fresh onions. Bag weights such as 5, 10, 20, 25 or 50 kg can be chosen to suit your market.

## 5. Destination rules
Import regulations, labelling and permitted pesticide residue limits differ by country. Share your requirements early so they can be reflected in the quotation.

To discuss a specification for your market, send us a quote request.

posts.title: Why ventilation matters when shipping fresh onions
posts.excerpt: Onions are living produce. Airflow, dryness and temperature during storage and transport decide the condition on arrival.
posts.body:
Fresh onions continue to breathe after harvest. If they are packed or stored without airflow, heat and moisture build up and the risk of rot and sprouting rises.

## Packing for airflow
Mesh bags let air move through the load. Cartons or sacks without ventilation can trap moisture, so they are not recommended for long journeys unless designed for the purpose.

## Stowing the load
Whether the cargo moves by road or in a container, the goods should be stowed so that air can circulate. Overloading and tight stacking restrict airflow.

## Keep it dry
Onions should be cured and dry before packing. Wet or freshly harvested onions are much more likely to deteriorate in transit.

## Plan the timeline
The quicker onions move from sorting to the destination, the better the condition on arrival. Good coordination between packing, documentation and freight booking helps avoid waiting time at ports and borders.

Our team coordinates packing and logistics with your freight arrangements. Contact us to discuss your shipment.

posts.title: Documents importers usually ask for when buying onions from India
posts.excerpt: A short overview of the paperwork that commonly accompanies an agricultural export shipment from India.
posts.body:
Every country has its own import requirements, but the following documents commonly appear in an agricultural export shipment from India. Exact requirements depend on the destination and are confirmed per order.

## Commercial documents
- Proforma and commercial invoice
- Packing list
- Bill of lading or airway bill, or a road transport document for overland shipments

## Regulatory documents
- Phytosanitary certificate, issued for the shipment when the destination requires it
- Certificate of origin, if requested by the buyer or the destination country
- Any additional certificates or test reports agreed in the contract

## Exporter registrations
An exporter from India needs an Import Export Code (IEC). Depending on the product and the route, other registrations may also apply.

## Be clear on terms
Agree the Incoterms, payment terms and inspection method in writing before shipping. If you are unsure which documents your country requires, tell us and we will help coordinate them.
